Maya: Quick signup: `@name - pick - meet - notes`
Tom: `@Tom - yoga - rooftop - will bring 2 mats`
Rico: `@Rico - run - park - be there 12:35`
Ana: `@Ana - yoga - rooftop - will lead 10-min core sequence`
Zoe: `@Zoe - run - park - headphones ready`
Maya: Looks like 3 yoga / 2 run biased. Poll time: react with :lotus: for yoga, :running: for run.
FitBot: Poll posted: "Lunchtime: Rooftop Yoga vs 2K Tempo" (expires in 1h).
Rico: :running: trying to beat my Tuesday split
Tom: :lotus: sorry runner friends, my back wins today
Ana: :lotus: core + pigeon stretch incoming
Zoe: :running: trade: winner picks smoothie flavor?

FitBot: Reminder set for 12:20 tomorrow: "Rooftop Yoga vs 2K Tempo". React with :bell: to confirm.
